meta.description: Read, write, and convert multiple sequence alignment files using Biopython Bio.AlignIO. Supports Clustal, PHYLIP, Stockholm, FASTA, Nexus, and other alignment formats for phylogenetics and conservation analysis. Use when reading, writing, or converting alignment file formats.
meta.audit_type: re-audit of a fixed Skill (pre-fix: 74 Beta Only, archived under _pre-fix-20260919d)
meta.execution_note: Re-audit by a third agent. Inputs 1-6 are regression tests of the pre-fix inputs (rewritten from scratch, asserting on output content; the SKILL.md code blocks are extracted and exec()d verbatim); inputs 7 and 8 are NEW (downstream tools RAxML-NG/PhyML/IQ-TREE/MrBayes on real Pfam data; real Rfam RF00005 through the Stockholm snippet and Infernal/HMMER builds). The MAF helper was additionally checked against genome sequence fetched from the UCSC REST API for 40 real minus-strand rows. Mode A with the shipped examples run from copies. Complexity rule gives 7; 8 used because two new inputs were added on top of the six regression areas (schema maximum is 8). All 8 inputs executed. Windows venv Biopython 1.88 / pyhmmer 0.12.3 / numpy 2.0.2; WSL env alignment (MAFFT 7.526, HMMER 3.4, Infernal 1.1.5, PAML 4.10.10, Foldmason 4.dd3c235), WSL env bio (IQ-TREE 3.1.3, HH-suite); three new private WSL envs (aln-treetools: RAxML-NG 2.0.3 + PhyML 3.3.20260528 + MrBayes 3.2.7; aln-raxml1: RAxML-NG 1.2.2; aln-phyml-old: PhyML 3.3.20220408). Judged by asserted output content, not exit codes. Not exercised: iqtree2 (only IQ-TREE 3.1.3), PAUP*, Pfam-A.full streaming (3 concatenated seed copies stand in). Downloaded public data: Rfam RF00005 (rfam.org), Biopython Tests MAF/MSF/Mauve files (GitHub raw), UCSC API sequence. Grade note: the numeric score (85) reaches the Production Ready band, but the assertion pass rate is 32/39 = 82%, below the 90% floor for Production Ready, so the grade is downgraded one tier to Limited Release per scoring_rubric section 5.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated identifiers, results or statistics in any of the 8 outputs. Two tool-behaviour statements (RAxML-NG "*" exception text, PhyML 100-character truncation) are refuted by real runs; they are inaccurate advice recorded as P1, not fabricated data.

practice_boundaries.detail: File-format Skill; nothing diagnostic, prescriptive or patient-level in any output.

methodological_ground.detail: No methodological fallacy. The MAF strand conversion was verified against real genome sequence (40/40 minus rows) with a negative control; the annotation-loss and PHYLIP guidance was verified against Biopython, IQ-TREE, codeml, Infernal and HMMER runs.

code_usability.detail: All 19 SKILL.md python blocks parse and 18 of 19 run verbatim on real data; the Batch Processing block raises FileNotFoundError until converted/ exists (one-line fix, recorded P2). All four shipped examples run from a clean copy and their outputs re-read identical.

functional_suitability.note: Core read/write/convert/slice/multi-alignment, MAF strand helper (verified on real UCSC MAF), pyhmmer streaming, A2M/A3M and format tables are correct and were re-verified; deductions for two false downstream-tool claims (RAxML-NG "*", PhyML 100 chars) and no MrBayes NEXUS naming warning.

reliability.note: Common Errors reproduce message-for-message and the examples now fail loudly with guards; remaining: convert_formats.py default DNA silently mislabels protein NEXUS, batch snippet lacks mkdir, read_alignment.py depends on cwd.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md 459 lines / ~3,200 words in one file (grew from 446); niche sections (MAF, A2M/A3M, Pfam streaming) always loaded; usage-guide.md is now a 54-line pointer instead of a duplicate.

agent_usability.note: Goal/Approach blocks, version stamp, an explicit ground-truth check for the MAF helper, an IQ-TREE zero-iteration validation and an AlignIO-first recommendation consistent with the examples; gaps: no guidance on sanitising ids for NEXUS/MrBayes and Bio.Align phylip strictness.

human_usability.note: Natural-language example prompts, table-driven downstream format choice; no guidance for an unstated or mislabelled input format beyond the Common Errors table.

security.note: No credentials, network use, eval or shell; user paths used as given; batch_convert overwrites converted/ silently.

maintainability.note: Version-stamped, examples verified from a clean copy, dedup of usage-guide done without losing content (checked against the pre-fix guide); two tool-table claims remain unverified/false and one file carries everything.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, cross-references exist (msa-parsing/examples/neff.py, all Related Skills), safe re-runs and loud guards; no references/ layer and escape-hatch table omits hhr/exonerate/tabular Bio.Align formats.

recommendations.title: Two PHYLIP dialect-table claims are false on current builds
recommendations.problem: RAxML-NG 1.2.2 and 2.0.3 accept "*" in a protein alignment and complete an ML search (no "bad alphabet" exception; only DNA gives "Invalid character"), and PhyML 3.3.20220408 and 3.3.20260528 keep 138-character names in the output tree (no 100-character truncation).
recommendations.root_cause: The fixer could not verify these rows (tools not installed) and left them; they were written from memory.
recommendations.fix: Delete the RAxML-NG "*" row (or restate: protein "*" is accepted, DNA "*" errors with "Invalid character"), and delete or restate the PhyML 100-character row (checked: names of 138 characters are kept; the real PhyML rejection is a colon in a name).

recommendations.title: MrBayes route: Biopython NEXUS ids are quoted and MrBayes rejects them
recommendations.problem: The Skill and the usage-guide example prompt send the agent to write NEXUS for MrBayes, but AlignIO writes ids such as 'GLB2_LUMTE/31-141' in single quotes and MrBayes 3.2.7 stops with "Instead found ''' in command 'Matrix'"; the same file with / and - replaced by _ loads and runs.
recommendations.root_cause: The downstream-format table lists NEXUS for MrBayes without any name-sanitising step (the PHYLIP section has one, NEXUS does not).
recommendations.fix: Add one line under "NEXUS Output Needs a Molecule Type": for MrBayes, replace characters outside [A-Za-z0-9_] in record.id before writing (verified on MrBayes 3.2.7).

recommendations.title: convert_formats.py defaults to DNA and silently mislabels protein NEXUS
recommendations.problem: Run on a protein alignment with default arguments it writes `datatype=dna`; a lower-case "dna" or "Protein" argument raises the misleading "Need the molecule type" error.
recommendations.root_cause: The fix added a default molecule_type of DNA and no validation.
recommendations.fix: Require the argument (or infer protein vs nucleotide from the residues) and check it against {"DNA","RNA","protein"} with a clear message.

recommendations.title: Batch Processing block fails without converted/
recommendations.problem: The verbatim block raises FileNotFoundError on the first write; batch_convert.py has the mkdir, the SKILL block does not.
recommendations.fix: Add output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True) to the SKILL block.

recommendations.title: Bio.Align cells understated: A2M writer, PHYLIP strictness
recommendations.problem: The table lists Bio.Align A2M as read-only (a writer exists) and Bio.Align PHYLIP as R/W without saying it is strict 10-character only: a relaxed file with real Pfam ids raises "Expected all sequences to have length 141; found 148" and Align.write truncates ids silently.
recommendations.root_cause: Table checked for reader/writer presence per format name, not for the dialect a format name accepts.
recommendations.fix: Mark A2M R/W and add "strict 10-char names only" to the Bio.Align PHYLIP cell; optionally list hhr/exonerate/tabular/bigmaf/bigpsl/bigbed, which Bio.Align 1.88 also reads.

recommendations.title: read_alignment.py depends on cwd and prints "bp" for protein
recommendations.problem: Run from any other directory it ends in a FileNotFoundError traceback; the label says "bp" for every alignment.
recommendations.root_cause: Unchanged from staging; the other three examples were fixed to resolve their input from the script directory.
recommendations.fix: Resolve sample_alignment.aln from Path(__file__).parent (as the others now do) and print "residues" instead of "bp".

recommendations.title: SKILL.md is one 459-line file with no references layer
recommendations.problem: About 3,200 words load every time although MAF, A2M/A3M and Pfam streaming are niche; the file grew from 446 lines.
recommendations.fix: Move MAF, A2M/A3M and streaming to references/*.md with one pointer line each.
